{{Top|leg}}
'''Vishnare''' was an architect on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] that made a bet against [[Teela Kaarz]] that she could not redesign a dining hall on short notice due to a mistranslation of a measurement system, from [[Trogan meter]]s to [[Meter/Legends|Imperial standard meters]]. He lost the bet and saluted Teela in the [[Hard Heart Cantina/Legends|Hard Heart Cantina]].
